name: Vignette: a photo of the two of you
body: Photo mode with a sight that counts only when both of you are in frame; in chapter 5 only the player is, or she will not stay in the shot.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean's 'Gameplay Direction: Finding Her' doc (searching as the core mechanic, not a platformer).

acceptance_criteria: A photo counts when she is in frame
The ch5 state has no one to frame
